lines.x: Zambia's state-owned ZCCM Investment Holdings plans to invest $2.7 billion over ten years in mining, metals trading and electricity generation.
Mines Minister Brenda Tambatamba said the government is determined to position Zambia as a leading global copper producer.
S&P Global Ratings raised Zambia's sovereign credit rating from CCC+/C to B-/B with a stable outlook, citing economic improvement, debt restructuring progress and fiscal reforms.
Zambia authorized payouts to farmers who supplied maize to the Food Reserve Agency, backed by a $715 million state budget line.
